title: AnyMAC: Cascading Flexible Multi-Agent Collaboration via Next-Agent Prediction
authors: Song Wang; Zhen Tan; Zihan Chen; Shuang Zhou; Tianlong Chen; Jundong Li
venue_full: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2025
affiliations: University of Virginia (Song Wang, Zihan Chen, Jundong Li);
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM multi-agent collaboration relies on static or graph-based inter-agent topologies, which limit adaptability/flexibility and confine communication to a comparatively small topology space. The paper asks how to build task-adaptive agent communication pipelines that flexibly choose which role acts next and which prior context each step reads, while reducing communication overhead.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 LLM 多 agent 協作依賴靜態或以圖為基礎的 agent 間 topology,這類設計限制了適應性與彈性,並將通訊侷限於相對狹小的 topology 空間。本文探討如何建構任務自適應的 agent 通訊管線,使其能彈性地選擇下一步由哪個角色行動,以及每一步應讀取哪些先前的 context,同時降低通訊開銷。

key_innovation.en: Reframes multi-agent coordination as a SEQUENTIAL cascade (not a graph): a learned routing model performs Next-Agent Prediction (pick the best role at each step) and Next-Context Selection (each step selectively reads outputs from any previous step), building a per-query task-adaptive linear pipeline trained by reinforcement learning with an efficiency-aware, length-decayed reward.
key_innovation.zh: 本文將多 agent 協調重新表述為一種循序 (sequential) 級聯結構,而非圖結構:由一個學習得到的路由模型執行 Next-Agent Prediction (在每一步選出最佳角色) 與 Next-Context Selection (每一步選擇性地讀取任意先前步驟的輸出),藉此為每一個 query 建構任務自適應的線性管線,並以具效率感知、長度衰減 (length-decayed) 獎勵的 reinforcement learning 進行訓練。

baselines_compared: CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency, PHP, Chain, Star, Tree, Complete Graph, Random Graph, AutoGen

key_improvements.en: AnyMAC reaches state-of-the-art average accuracy 90.62% across six benchmarks vs strongest baseline G-Designer 89.84% (+0.78 avg). Per-dataset (gain vs vanilla): MMLU 84.30% (+2.16), GSM8K 95.66% (+10.26), MultiArith 99.44% (+6.29), SVAMP 92.67% (+5.49), AQuA 81.50% (+11.16), HumanEval 90.12% (+18.44). Robustness under an injected malicious agent: AnyMAC drops only -1.3% vs up to -11.0% for other methods.
key_improvements.zh: AnyMAC 在六項 benchmark 上達到最先進的平均準確率 90.62%,優於最強 baseline G-Designer 的 89.84% (平均 +0.78)。各資料集表現 (相對 vanilla 的增益):MMLU 84.30% (+2.16)、GSM8K 95.66% (+10.26)、MultiArith 99.44% (+6.29)、SVAMP 92.67% (+5.49)、AQuA 81.50% (+11.16)、HumanEval 90.12% (+18.44)。在注入惡意 agent 情境下的穩健性:AnyMAC 僅下降 -1.3%,而其他方法最多下降 -11.0%。GSM8K 消融實驗 (完整 95.66%):去除 task embedding 為 93.87%、去除 NAP 為 94.75%、去除 NCS 為 94.35%。

structure_space: Roles / profiles, Temporal / cross-round edges, Team composition (agent set), Termination / depth
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, SVAMP, AQuA, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: A single-domain reasoning/coding MAS where all executing agents are LLM instances (gpt-4-1106-preview) instantiated with dynamically chosen role profiles (e.g., "Knowledgeable Expert", "Lawyer") drawn from a candidate role set R. Instead of a fixed graph, a small learned router (GPT-2 Small) sequentially assembles a linear pipeline of up to 5 role-playing agents; each agent may selectively read any subset of earlier agents' outputs (NCS), giving global information flow along the cascade. No external tools are described; the protocol is text-message passing along the learned sequence.
agent_scenario.zh: 此為單一領域的推理/程式撰寫 MAS,所有執行的 agent 皆為以動態選定角色設定 (例如「Knowledgeable Expert」、「Lawyer」) 實例化的 LLM (gpt-4-1106-preview),角色取自候選角色集合 R。有別於固定的圖結構,一個小型的學習路由器 (GPT-2 Small) 循序組裝出最多 5 個角色扮演 agent 的線性管線;每個 agent 可選擇性地讀取任意先前 agent 輸出的子集 (NCS),使資訊得以沿級聯結構全域流動。文中未描述任何外部工具;其協定為沿學習得到的序列傳遞的 text-message passing。
